priorityOutcomes.desired: A small recognizable wreck with a long worn hull, physically coherent mast/crossbar and small cabin. Replace abrupt slabs with soft crafted volumes and selected broken/plank structure. Preserve a restrained, elongated distant silhouette; make E/W native views coherent rather than paper thin.
priorityOutcomes.freedom: Native remodeling, small silhouette changes, purposeful details and topology/part-count changes are encouraged. Exact original surface support shape/count are not locks.

priorityOutcomes.desired: Blue timber remains dominant and quiet enough behind submarine/creature silhouettes. A small muted warm exposed-wood or moss accent may clarify construction. Large white barnacle spots, bright golden rim light, saturated foliage and foreground contrast must not take over. Materials should separate without dark outlines or tiny high-contrast scratches.

Broad soft highlights reveal rounded timber and cabin volume in every facing. Horizontal light treatment is symmetric, with no preferred side, rim glow, cast ground shadow, blown edge bands or black lower dead spots.

additionalOutcomes.materialDetail: Coarse meaningful plank/wear/rope/accretion grouping can evoke the fixed target. Details must be readable and purposeful at registered scale; target microdetail, exact barnacle counts and seaweed strips are not required.
additionalOutcomes.useSize: At logical128px/cell, phone32px/cell and fractional47.3px/cell the mast/crossbar/hull grouping remains readable. E/W may naturally be narrower, but should show a deliberately made coherent end profile. At phone size the prop remains subordinate to submarine-yellow and creature-eel.
additionalOutcomes.artifactFree: All4 native facings have clean alpha edges, coherent joins between owned parts, no floating mast/cabin, no z-fighting, coplanar flicker, intersecting highlight seams, clipped frames, per-view treatment, target fringe speckles or texture swimming. Natural broken edges are intentional native forms, not render defects.

additionalOutcomes.temporal: One true static frame at12fps; hold at0,1/12,11/12 and2seconds remains unchanged. No invented ambient sway or shader animation.
